profile.description: Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG develops, finances, designs, constructs, operates, maintains, insures, and owns power-generating facilities in Oman. The company owns and operates the Barka 3 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW; gas interconnection facilities; and other related infrastructure to produce power. It sells electrical energy to Nama Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC under power purchase agreement. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah, Oman.
